notes.title: Update Notes - 16 August 2022
notes.content:
This is a bug fix and polish update, plus an additional QOL option for controller & Steam Deck players.

[list]
[*] Added cursor speed option when using a joypad or Steam Deck to play the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where invalid autosaves could be created after the game was completed.
[*] Added social media links on the main menu. 
[*] Fixed a handful of text errors.
[/list]
